aus.headline: RBA Lifts Cash Rate To 4.85%
aus.body: Australia's central bank has hiked its official rate target again, now 4.85 per cent.
aus.why: Variable mortgage repayments go up again for borrowers.

us.headline: Apple Results Let Down Wall Street

us.why: Moves on Wall Street often set the tone for the ASX.
